question.text: One mole of a van der Waals' gas obeying the equation $\left(p+\frac{a}{V^{2}}\right)(V-b)=R T$ undergoes the quasi-static cyclic process which is shown in the $p \cdot V$ diagram. The net heat absorbed by the gas in this process is

solution.text: For the cyclic process Heat absorbed = Work done $$ \begin{array}{l} =\text { Area }=\frac{1}{2}(\Delta p) \times \Delta V \\ =\frac{1}{2}\left(p_{1}-p_{2}\right) \times\left(V_{1}-V_{2}\right) \\ =\frac{1}{2}\left(p_{1}-p_{2}\right)\left(V_{1}-V_{2}\right) \end{array} $$
